nom: TULA 24-7 Moisture Hydrating Day & Night Cream

segments.oily: Some oily-skin reviewers say it absorbs quickly and does not appear greasy or slick, though one reports it turned oily on her skin within hours.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers most often praise it as deeply hydrating and non-flaky, though one with mature dry skin found it underwhelming compared to Cerave and one with dry skin experienced stinging and redness on damp or freshly washed skin.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers (including acne-prone and sensitive-combination) describe it as lightweight, non-breakout-causing and good under makeup, with one exception reporting acne-like breakouts.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: many call it their only moisturizer that doesn't irritate and highlight it as gentle even with eczema or reactive skin, but several others report rash, burning, stinging or cyst-like breakouts, including one who suspects a formula change caused a new allergic reaction.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers report reduced look of fine lines and forehead lines with regular use, though one found it merely average compared to a drugstore alternative.

concerns.aging: Reviewers over 50 and others mention softer skin and reduced appearance of forehead lines and the '11s', with one noting wrinkle reduction that faded within hours.
concerns.dehydration: This is the most consistently praised effect: reviewers across skin types describe it as deeply and lastingly hydrating, including in winter and after tretinoin use, with no dissent found on this point.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report reduced redness or fading of a rash-like patch after use; one reviewer with dry sensitive skin says her general redness persisted despite otherwise good tolerance.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers describe it as protective alongside tretinoin or drying routines, preventing irritation and dryness, though others describe burning, stinging or rash suggesting barrier irritation instead.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports fading acne scars with continued use; no other spot-specific outcomes are mentioned.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including several acne-prone ones, report no new breakouts and some improvement in smoothness, but multiple reviewers describe clogged pores, whiteheads, small bumps or cystic-like acne after use.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers describe it as non-greasy and lightweight even on oily skin, but a small number report it turning oily or sitting on top of the skin after a few hours.

extraits.texte: I really wanted to love this because I love the cult classic wash and needed a new moisturizer for winter. However, it felt greasy on my skin and made me break out terribly. Small bumps and white heads all over my cheeks despite my t-zone usually being the problem spot.

I got one of those free big size sample and i was so excited to try this! Wish i read the reviews but ya live and you learn! I never really had issues with acne until using this. I have had almost cyst like acne on my foregead since i added this product into my routine in December. On dry skin or freshley washed skin, this product stung and left my forehead red. Hopefully it works for someone but the pros were it felt lightweight and buildable! Wish it wasnt so expensive, lightweight, and didnt cause me any reactions. Would recommend steering clear if you have a histpry of sensitive skin (even if its a free sample!)

I have dry and very sensitive skin. While my general redness did persist, I'm happy to say this moisturizer didn't give me any major breakouts. Overall, this product was moisturizing and preformed best when applied to damp skin. I would recommend using it at nighttime so it has a chance to really soak in. I felt that this moisturizer sat on top of my skin a little bit. I use bare minerals complexion rescue tinted moisturizer, which I noticed tends to pill when I use TULA beforehand, even when I wait 20+ minutes after applying the moisturizer. My partner likes this moisturizer, and I may continue to buy it for him. But I will likely move on to something else.

I bought this product to try out as i have rarely found a facial moisturizer i like or that agrees with my exzema prone skin. I fell in love with this one! Its smooth to go on, leaves my skin hydrated all day and doesnt itritate my skin or break me out. I bought the 1.5 oz size and it lasted me about four months of day and night use as you dont need a lot of product for it to do the job! Im very impressed and would recommend to anyone who is looking for a lightweight and sensitive skin friendly daily moisturizer!

I have a bright red nose with dry skin and pimples ever since getting pregnant in 2022, been pregnant basically since and still will be until April 2026. I've fought so hard with this I'm pretty much known to be Rudolph now. Don't know even how I came by this moisturizer or how it got in my cabinet but I opened the box the other day and started using a finger tip amount all over my face and woke up and my nose looked like actual normal colored skin and no flaky skin after the first night. I'm very happy with it so far. Only been using one time at night after a shower may that be 3 to 5 times a week.

Tula's 24/7 Moisture cream is excellent as an everyday moisturizer. I use it after applying my Tretinoin treatment product and it keeps my skin from getting irritated and dry. My oily skin can wear this without appearing greasy and feeling slick.

Simply amazing hydration without feeling heavy or greasy. A little bit goes a long way. I use it in the morning and at night and have seen big improvement in my skin…. less redness, increased brightness and decreased fine lines. I would definitely recommend to anyone looking for a great hydrating cream that is clean.
